from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, subprocess, difflib
main = Path('/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill')
rel = 'docs/clang-fix-campaign/p49-terminal-batch-design-v1.31-FROZEN.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(main), 'show', 'HEAD:' + rel])
new = (main / rel).read_bytes()
old_sha = hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest()
new_sha = hashlib.sha256(new).hexdigest()
assert old_sha == 'd44584592b54bfaf1406c13369da5f2f6a5894fc3dd8de04b3905eadd6213c3f'
assert new_sha == '73dad3c6f2f30541998a228cfb05f83718cd1273e2948b4d23b13d0941b6079e'
a, b = old.splitlines(keepends=True), new.splitlines(keepends=True)
ops = [op for op in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a, b, autojunk=False).get_opcodes() if op[0] != 'equal']
assert len(ops) == 2 and all(op[0] == 'insert' for op in ops), ops
assert ops[0][1] == 3 and ops[1][1] == len(a), ops
print('old_sha256=' + old_sha)
print('new_sha256=' + new_sha)
print('append_only=PASS additions=' + str(sum(j2-j1 for _,i1,i2,j1,j2 in ops)) + ' deletions=0')
print('insertions=' + repr(ops))
print(subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(main), 'diff', '--no-ext-diff', '--unified=0', '--', rel], text=True), end='')
